Flows are hemorrhaging. We are tracking $12B in net outflows from ESG-focused strategies week-over-week, a stark reversal from the 2025 inflows. This capital is not rotating into traditional oil; it is fleeing to T-Bills and cash equivalents, creating a massive liquidity vacuum in the energy derivatives market. Repo rate spreads on energy collateral have blown out to 75bps, signaling acute stress in the secured funding channels. We maintain zero delta exposure to the power grid infrastructure, viewing the sector as a toxic asset class until the 2027 debt restructuring cycle clears the insolvency rot. The "Bad Mood" is justified; the grid is failing, and the capital required to fix it does not exist.
